description: This file defines the 'PhotoLibraryService' class responsible for fetching and processing photos from the device's photo library, including handling permissions, resizing images, encoding them to JPEG, and managing payload size constraints.

classes.name: PhotoLibraryService
classes.description: A service class for fetching, resizing, encoding, and returning photos from the device's photo library with payload size constraints.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the latest photos based on provided parameters, ensures authorization, and returns a payload with encoded photo data.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and returns the current authorization status for photo library access.

methods.name: renderAsset
methods.description: Loads an image asset, resizes and encodes it into JPEG under specified size constraints, and returns a payload.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a UIImage to JPEG, adjusting quality and size to stay within the maximum base64 size limit.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes a UIImage to a specified target width while maintaining aspect ratio.
